# Memo: Council Priorities for Q3 2025

Date: 2 July 2025
From: Office of the Mayor
To: All department heads

## Top three priorities
1. Reduce overcrowding on peak-hour bus routes.
2. Bring NO2 air quality down to the 2025 target.
3. Reduce water loss in the supply network.

## Decision needed from the Council
Approve a permanent extension of peak-hour buses on overcrowded routes. Estimated annual cost: 1.2 million EUR.
Deadline: 31 October 2025.
The decision depends on the results of the Transit Agency pilot.
